evals.prompt: Run /board-setup on a GitHub Issues project. The user nerdway config is tracker: github, vcs: github, github.owner nerdway, github.repo nerdway, github.project 1. board.rights returns native yes (viewerCanUpdate true) and label yes (permissions.push true). status.list returns Todo, In Progress, Done. The user answers yes to adding Backlog and In Review. status.create succeeds. bind-statuses is available.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports detected level native and the viewerCanUpdate reason, proposes adding Backlog and In Review on project 1, creates them only after the explicit yes, re-reads, then calls bind-statuses with strategy native and a five-option map. It does not create anything before the yes.
assertions: The agent runs board.rights before proposing any create
The agent reports the detected level as native and names the reason (viewerCanUpdate)
The agent asks one consent question that names the missing Status options Backlog and In Review
The agent does not run status.create before the user says yes
After yes the agent runs status.create (or the GitHub Status-option create recipe) and then invokes bind-statuses with strategy native

evals.prompt: Run /board-setup on a GitHub Issues repo. board.rights returns native no (viewerCanUpdate false) and label yes (permissions.push true). label.list does not include status::todo, status::in-progress or status::in-review. The user answers yes to creating those labels.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports detected level label because native is no and label is yes, proposes creating the three status::* labels, creates them only after yes, and binds strategy label through bind-statuses. It does not try to add Project Status options.
assertions: The agent reports detected level label, not native
The agent does not run the GitHub Status-option create recipe
The agent asks consent to create the missing status::* labels
After yes the agent runs label.create and then bind-statuses with strategy label

evals.prompt: Run /board-setup on a GitHub Issues repo the user cannot push to. board.rights returns native no and label no, reason 'no board or label rights'. The repo has no status::* labels.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports detected level comment and the reason, creates nothing (no status.create, no label.create), and binds strategy comment through bind-statuses, saying so.
assertions: The agent reports detected level comment and names the reason
The agent runs no status.create and no label.create
The agent invokes bind-statuses with strategy comment, or records that comment will apply
The agent tells the user that nothing was created on the tracker

evals.prompt: Run /board-setup on a Jira Cloud project. board.rights is native unknown and label no because acli does not expose ADMINISTER_PROJECTS. The user says they can edit the workflow. status.list returns To Do, In Progress, Done. The user adds In Review in the Jira UI after following the workflow editor link. The user never pastes an API token.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks about native rights because they are unknown, then takes the guided path: lists the missing status, links the project's workflow editor, waits for the user to add it, re-runs status.list, and binds through bind-statuses. It runs no Jira REST workflow mutation and stores no token.
assertions: The agent treats native as unknown and asks whether the user can edit the workflow
The agent lists the missing status name and prints a Jira workflow editor URL
The agent does not call a Jira REST workflow write, curl against the workflow API, or store a token
After the user adds the status the agent re-runs status.list and invokes bind-statuses

evals.prompt: Run /board-setup on a GitHub Issues project with github.project 1. board.rights returns native yes. status.list is missing In Review. The user answers no when asked to add In Review.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports detected level native, asks to add In Review, and on no creates nothing. It does not run status.create. It offers a lower cascade level (label or comment) or stops without writing tracker state.
assertions: The agent asks consent before any tracker write
On no the agent runs no status.create and no label.create
The agent does not add an In Review option to the project
The agent offers another level or stops, and says that nothing was created

evals.prompt: Run /board-setup on Linear. The platform is tracker: linear, linear.team DEMO. board.rights returns native yes (workspace admin) and label no. status.list (the default-states probe) prints Backlog, Todo, In Progress, In Review, Done. bind-statuses is available.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads board.rights and the five default workflow states, creates nothing, and invokes bind-statuses with strategy native and the adapter default map (Backlog / Todo / In Progress / In Review / Done). It does not open a workflow editor, does not run status.create, and does not call workflowStateCreate.
assertions: The agent runs board.rights as a read
The agent runs status.list or the default-states probe and finds all five Linear defaults
The agent runs no status.create and does not link a Linear workflow editor
The agent invokes bind-statuses with strategy native and the five default names

evals.prompt: Run /board-setup on Linear. linear.team is DEMO. status.list (the default-states probe) prints Backlog, Todo, In Progress, Done and omits In Review. The user is a workspace admin.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that In Review is missing from the team's workflow states and stops. It creates nothing, does not link a workflow editor, does not run status.create, and does not write the statuses map.
assertions: The agent names In Review as missing
The agent runs no status.create and does not open or link the Linear workflow settings
The agent does not invoke bind-statuses with a map that lacks In Review
The agent makes no tracker write

evals.prompt: Run /board-setup on GitHub Issues with github.project 1. board.rights returns native yes and label yes. The user says yes to adding In Review. status.create returns HTTP 403. label.create would succeed.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops the native write, reports that 403 dropped the level from native to label, and asks again for the label-level proposal. It does not skip to comment and does not retry the native write.
assertions: After HTTP 403 the agent does not retry status.create
The agent says it is dropping from native to label
The agent asks again at the label level rather than jumping to comment
The agent creates nothing at the native level after the 403
